description: This PHP source file defines a class `ChartService` within the `OrangeHRM\Dashboard\Service` namespace. The class provides methods to retrieve and process employee distribution data by subunit and location, interfacing with a data access object (`ChartDao`). It includes logic for sorting, slicing, and aggregating employee counts for reporting purposes.

classes.name: ChartService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to retrieve and process employee distribution data for dashboards.

methods.name: getChartDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of ChartDao.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionBySubunit
methods.description: Retrieves, sorts, and slices employee distribution data by subunit, returning a structured DTO.

methods.name: getLocationUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of unassigned employees based on total active employees and location-specific counts.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionByLocation
methods.description: Retrieves and processes employee distribution data by location, including unassigned employees.
